# Third-party material

- `vendor/scrawl/` is the MIT-licensed source of
  [fergousA/scrawl](https://github.com/fergousA/scrawl), vendored to keep the
  package self-contained for rough vector frames.
- Geometric examples depend on `@preview/ctz-euclide:0.2.0`, which Typst will
  download from the package registry when needed.
- `assets/fonts/Amiri-*` are distributed under the SIL Open Font License; its
  full text is included in `assets/fonts/OFL-Amiri.txt`.
